note: Modeled deterministic consumption-contract vectors, in the ROS2 request/expect form. candidateEnvelope supplies an already evaluated envelope fixture, not an A/E computation formula. trustedFixtures represent independently established verification/status outcomes and do not claim cryptographic verification or real measurement. Every vector begins with all other required contracts satisfied. decision is a derived vector reading, never a new wire result enum. tighter outcomes are permitted for monotonic pairs; S33 withholds the oversized request; S34 preserves the supervision floor and ceilings. Runtime implementations and real signature/current-state acquisition are external; vector/schema checks are prerequisites, never runtime certification. The trustedFixtures flags are supplied assumptions, and passing those cases does not establish the runtime contract. conditions supplies the governing observed values of repairPathVerified and supervisionAvailable.
timeNotation: All vector times/ages are fixed integer milliseconds, including proof and observation deadlines; wire-schema decision times are integer Unix seconds. No real clock, target effect or source measurement is represented. The installed observation-time resolution in these fixtures is one millisecond.

schemaFixtureNote: Synthetic shape-only fixture. Digest strings and JWS segments are placeholders, not verified digests, a valid signature or an ordinary proof. It must never be used as authority. schemaVectors apply each isolated mutation to a fresh copy; omitted mutation means unchanged. Schema acceptance does not imply temporal, binding, token-representation or cryptographic acceptance.

rationale: Modeled shape fixture; not signed authority.

cryptographicFixtureNote: Test key is public and has no authority. These cases require verifying compact ES256 JWS signatures and independently hashing the RFC 8785 actual request-binding object and complete ASCII proof. All other trustedFixtures are assumptions.
